how1: Thayipha abakuthengayo (noma thepha okuthi 🍚 Ilayisi, isikhwama esingu-20 lb ngezintengo zangempela zemakethe).
how2: Faka izindleko zeyodwa yase-United States (noma thepha i-chip).
how4: Engeza umamukeli ngamunye: thepha izwe, engeza igama / inhlangano esiza abantulayo.
how5: Umugqa ngamunye ukhombisa ukuthi yini okufanele uyithumele; thayipha inani langempela lendawo uma ulazi.
how6: Ingqikithi ingezansi; thepha Kopisha uhlelo ukuze wabelane.
how7: Noma vula uhlu lwezifiso zenjongo: khetha abakudingayo, kopisha inothi, bese unikeza ngekhasi lemishini.
howp: Lokhu kuhlela amanani. Ayithumeli imali noma iqinisekise izinhlangano ezisiza umphakathi. Nikeza ngekhasi elisemthethweni lemishini ngayinye.
tagline: Nikeza ukuze ngamunye akwazi ukuthenga okufanayo.
nosend: Lolu hlelo lokusebenza aluthumeli imali noma luqinisekise izinhlangano ezisiza umphakathi. Nikeza ngekhasi elisemthethweni lemishini ngayinye.
about1: Amazinga wamanani asuka eBhange Lomhlaba (izinga lentengo yokusetshenziswa kwekhaya, ikakhulukazi u-2024; US = 100, agcinwe njengo-1.0). Amanani okushintshanisa abukhoma namuhla. Izindleko ezisemthethweni zezwe = Izindleko zase-US × i-PPP yasekhaya ka-2024, iphenduke amadola ngenani lanamuhla. Izintengo ezisemthethweni ziyizindleko zokuphila, akuyona into eyodwa yegrosa futhi hhayi inani lanamuhla lezintambo. Thayipha intengo uma eyangempela yaziwa (eboniswa “njengentengo yakho”).
about2: isebenzisa izintengo zangempela zerayisi ezimakethe esikhundleni sezinga lentengo: I-US evela ku-Bureau of Labor Statistics (uchungechunge APU0000701312, isilinganiso sedolobha lase-US), i-Haiti ne-Malawi evela ku-World Food Program (nge-HDX). Izintengo zasendaweni ziphendulwa amadola ngesilinganiso esibukhoma sanamuhla. 20 lb = 9.07 kg. Amazwe angenayo intengo yerayisi yemakethe asebenzisa izinga lentengo.
about3: Izintengo zohlu lwezifiso yizintengo zemakethe yokudayisa ye-World Food Program (nge-HDX) yendawo yemishini, imakethe nenyanga kukhonjiswe entweni ngayinye. Izinto ezingenayo intengo yemakethe zithi "intengo emiswe ngenhloso".
sentence: I-United States ithunyelwe {a} ( {b} × {n} ). Yonke enye indawo ithunyelwa izindleko zayo izikhathi zaleyo nombolo efanayo.
rates_unavail: ⚠ Izilinganiso ezibukhoma azitholakali — kusetshenziswa amanani eBhange Lomhlaba lango-2024 namazinga amanani.
machine_note: Ukuhumusha kwenziwa ngomshini. IsiNgisi yisona sokuqala.
wl_intro: Amamishini awakwazi ukulethwa amaphakheji; bathenga emakethe yangakubo. Khetha ukuthi i-mission idinga ini, bese udlulisela ekhasini layo ngenothi elingezansi ukuze imali ithenge lezi zinto endaweni.
wl_give_hint: Kopisha inothi, cindezela okuthi Nikeza ngokuqondile, bese ulinamathisela kunothi lesipho noma ebhokisini lememo.
wl_shared_warn: Uhlu lwezifiso olwabiwe: olwenziwe yinoma ubani othumele isixhumanisi. Hlola ukuthi isixhumanisi sokunikela siyikhasi langempela le-mission.
wl_m_items: Izinto, eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye: igama | intengo yendawo (shiya intengo ingenalutho uma ishintsha)
wl_bad: Engeza igama, isixhumanisi se-https:// kanye nento okungenani eyodwa.
